meta.description: An Android app for live video chat rooms: hosts open a room, guests join by paying with coins, and the conversation happens in real time.

intro.name: Viktor Nešić
intro.offer: Viktor Nešić is a senior mobile developer building native iOS, Android and Kotlin Multiplatform apps with Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. Available for freelance and contract projects, working remotely.

caseStudy.title: MuMe
caseStudy.lead: An Android app for live video chat rooms: hosts open a room, guests join by paying with coins, and the conversation happens in real time.

brief.title: The brief
text: Live conversations as a product: a host opens a room, guests pay a small amount of coins to join, and everyone talks in real time, face to face in video rooms or by voice in audio rooms.

contributions.title: What I did
items: Built the native Android app in Java with XML views.
Integrated Agora for the real-time video rooms and the audio rooms.
Built the chat inside the rooms on Firebase, which also serves as the app's backend.
Implemented joining a room with coins.

team.title: Team
team.text: I built the app myself, working directly with the client.

outcome.title: The result
outcome.text: A native Android app for paid live rooms, in video and in audio, with chat in every room.

cta.title: Have a project like this?
cta.text: I build and rescue native iOS, Android and Kotlin Multiplatform apps, and I'm happy to look at yours.

items.title: Video rooms
items.text: Hosts and guests see each other live, streamed through Agora.

items.title: Audio rooms
items.text: Voice-only rooms on the same Agora real-time engine.

items.title: Room chat
items.text: Messages next to the conversation, synced through Firebase.
